text:
maria gonzalez: Heads-up — AcmeFinance wants a quick POC next week. They need streaming responses with structured JSON output, function/tool calling for payments lookup, and an option for private deployment. They also sent a security questionnaire and asked about pricing for sustained 50k tokens/day.
devon li: Got it. Do we have a prebuilt sample for streaming + tool calls that maps to payments lookup?
raj patel: We have the payments-tool example in the SDK repo but it uses HTTP callbacks. Customer prefers websocket streaming and incremental JSON objects.
maria gonzalez: They specifically said "progressive JSON objects" to render rows as they stream. Concerned about partial JSON validity.
samira: We usually do newline-delimited JSON chunks over SSE / websockets. Frontend can assemble. Example: `data: {"row":1,"balance":100}` repeated. Works well with our streaming SDK.
raj patel: Warning: if they need strict JSON array per message we can do aggregate at end or send complete objects per chunk. Also recommend prefix caching to reduce token cost for repeated customer prompts.
alex_sales: Pricing question from procurement: how do we price 50k tokens/day steady for 12 months? They asked for both hosted and dedicated pricing.
maria gonzalez: Devon / finance — can you draft a ballpark? Also flag dedicated commit thresholds and SLA.
devon li: Ballpark: hosted ~ $0.0035 per token for high-quality model estimate (discount possible). Dedicated: monthly commit starting at $Xk with negotiated rate ~40% lower. I'll follow up with a spreadsheet.
raj patel: Security checklist: they require SOC2, KMS integration, SSO (SAML), IP allowlist, and audit logs. Can we commit to on-prem / VPC for POC?
samira: We can run Private in their VPC for POC but needs 2 weeks to prep infra + creds. For SSO we support SAML; engineering needs metadata from them. KMS integration requires HSM/KMS details — we can do BYOK in Private.
ci-bot: deploy-job #482 queued: private-poc-env for acmefinance (ETA ~ 14d)
maria gonzalez: Ok timeline sounds tight. Can we run hosted POC first with strict NDAs and ephemeral creds to validate integration (streaming + tool calls), then follow with private deployment?
raj patel: Yes — hosted POC for functional validation. Use function proxies to simulate on-prem KMS during hosted run. Also will add canary fallback to smaller model for reliability.
alex_sales: Customer asked for an SDK snippet to demo streaming + function call. Can someone paste a concise example we can include in the SOW?
samira: Paste this minimal node example:

const stream = new Redwood.Stream({ key: process.env.RW_KEY });
await stream.connect();
stream.on('data', chunk => {
  // each chunk is NDJSON: {"event":"tool_call","payload":{...}}\n});
stream.call('payments.lookup', { account_id: '1234' });

raj patel: Add note: use `structured_output_schema` in request to enforce fields and types. Example: `{"type":"object","properties":{"account_id":{"type":"string"},"balance":{"type":"number"}}}`
maria gonzalez: Next actions: 1) Devon to send pricing spreadsheet (by EOD). 2) Samira + Raj to produce a 1‑page hosted-POC runbook with SDK snippet and security mitigations (by tomorrow). 3) Alex to request SAML metadata + security questionnaire answers from customer.
alex_sales: On it. I'll ping procurement and ask for the questionnaire and a preferred POC start date.
devon li: Sending initial numbers now.
maria gonzalez: Thanks team — keep updates here. If anyone needs test credentials for the hosted POC ping ci-bot for ephemeral keys. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: ephemeral keys created: rw-ephemeral-7f3b (valid 72h)
